title: Ricotta and spinach gnocchi bake
summary: Ricotta and spinach gnocchi bake is a italian dinner built around fresh gnocchi and ricotta, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Ricotta and spinach gnocchi bake into even pieces and toss ricotta with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of ricotta while you season fresh gnocchi. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle fresh gnocchi and medium eggs among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Ricotta and spinach gnocchi bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Ricotta and spinach gnocchi bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the gnocchi, simmered in salted water until tender.
